brief.zh: 应用负责人怀疑“隐藏按钮”没有解决越权。围绕本机实验服务的O1/O2对象，以未登录、本人、他人和编辑权限实际发请求，复现后复验服务端整改。
brief.en: An application owner asks you to reproduce and repair object-level access. Test anonymous, owner, another user and edit permissions against a loopback service.

zh: 复现证据、修复或整改建议
授权测试矩阵和回归结果
en: an authorization matrix and regression evidence

zh: 本人/他人/未登录/不同动作响应符合契约
修复后正向功能与拒绝路径均验证
en: Reconcile the complete result with the supplied input IDs and values.
Hiding a button leaves an unauthorized server response exposed. This is a blocking regression.

failure.zh: 只隐藏前端按钮而服务端仍返回数据，必须失败
failure.en: Hiding a button leaves an unauthorized server response exposed.

zh: 不能扩成全应用安全认证
en: Locate the decision and supporting input/result in your deliverables.
Explain remaining uncertainty, your contribution and what the receiving role must verify.

environment.scope: Original small deterministic teaching application; no real enterprise traffic or model inference

zh: 应用负责人怀疑“隐藏按钮”没有解决越权。围绕本机实验服务的O1/O2对象，以未登录、本人、他人和编辑权限实际发请求，复现后复验服务端整改。
只隐藏前端按钮而服务端仍返回数据，必须失败；先制作能暴露这项错误的最小检查。
逐个核对输入和产物位置，保留修订前后、本人贡献与尚未验证范围。
en: An application owner asks you to reproduce and repair object-level access.
Reproduce this failure first: Hiding a button leaves an unauthorized server response exposed.
Check every result ID and preserve a before/after record; explain what this fixture cannot establish.

variants.scope: Fixed reviewed scenario and explicit extension. New constraints require a new review.
variants.newJudgment: 只隐藏前端按钮而服务端仍返回数据，必须失败
variants.status: fixed-base; new instances require explicit generation and frozen identities

sourceDescription.zh: 本站原创合成材料与代码，方法链接按阅读范围标注
sourceDescription.en: Original synthetic inputs and code; method links have bounded reading records

skillLinks.scope: Related task practice only; no completion or mastery award
